fusions.name: Furrow Sweep
fusions.desc: Sends the cloud through a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, which deals 11 damage to everything in it and leaves each one [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: A stripping bite that deals 18 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target (max 50%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Loosed Cloud
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Next Field Over
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
